notes: Live download URLs. Prefer aroma.foryour.cafe API endpoints over pinned GitHub asset URLs so Aroma updates flow through. GitHub extras use the releases/latest API.

base.description: Minimum SD contents for the current Aroma guide: payloads + Base Aroma.

recommended.description: Base plus the extra apps/plugins the official finalizing-setup page recommends.

pretendo.description: Optional Pretendo/Inkay plugin only. Do not install unless you intend to use Pretendo Network.

aroma-payloads.description: EnvironmentLoader + NAND dumper payloads (official Aroma 'Download Payloads').

aroma-extras.description: Bloopair, FTPiiU, SDCafiine, Screenshot, SwipSwapMe from aroma.foryour.cafe.

inkay.description: Pretendo Network plugin. Optional; skip for a first Aroma install.

savemii.description: SaveMii ProcessMod (Aroma) — Wii U / vWii save manager.
